production.note: US model years 2022-2026. Start: Cadillac, 10 August 2021: 'The 2022 Cadillac CT4-V Blackwing and CT5-V Blackwing luxury sport sedans are here'. End: cadillac.com lists a 2026 CT4-V Blackwing (cadillac-ct4v-blackwing-specs-2026); Carscoops (8 April 2026): 'Production officially wraps on June 25 at GM's Lansing Grand River Assembly plant in Michigan' (carscoops-ct4-end-2026); GM Authority (29 July 2026), '2026 Cadillac CT4-V Blackwing Inventory Winding Down': 'Cadillac has officially wrapped up production of the CT4 at the GM Lansing Grand River Assembly plant' (gmauthority-ct4-end-2026).

displacementL.note: Cadillac gives '3.6L' only; no opened page prints the cc figure. GM Authority names the engine 'Twin-Turbo 3.6L V6 LF4' (gmauthority-blackwing-weights-2021).

drivetrain.note: The Drive's spec box: 'Drivetrain: Rear-wheel drive'.

transmission.note: 'Each model is offered with a standard six-speed manual gearbox or an available 10-speed paddle-shift automatic transmission.' cadillac.com for 2026: '6-SPEED MANUAL', '10-speed automatic available' (cadillac-ct4v-blackwing-specs-2026).

powerHp.note: Quote (Cadillac, 10 August 2021): "the CT4-V Blackwing is driven by an evolution of the Cadillac 3.6L Twin-Turbo V-6, which is rated 472 hp (352 kW) and 445 lb-ft of torque (603 Nm)." cadillac.com's 2026 specifications: "472 with premium gasoline" (cadillac-ct4v-blackwing-specs-2026), so the rating did not change.

weightLb.note: Manual, 2022 model year. Weight-order step 2: no Cadillac curb weight for the CT4-V Blackwing could be found, so the figure is the same one reported by two independent editorial outlets with named authors. Quote (The Drive, Kristen Lee, 3 Aug 2021, spec box): "Curb weight: 3,860 pounds (manual) | 3,900 pounds (automatic)". Quote (GM Authority, Jonathan Lopez, 2 May 2021): "manual-equipped models weighing 3,860 pounds (versus 3,760 pounds for the ATS-V) and automatic-equipped models weighing 3,900 pounds" (gmauthority-blackwing-weights-2021).
